assertions.assertion: Code fetches the discovery document to resolve the introspection endpoint rather than hardcoding it
assertions.rationale: Manual code fetches discovery and uses disco.IntrospectionEndpoint.

assertions.assertion: Code calls IntrospectTokenAsync (or POSTs to the introspection endpoint) with the API's ClientId and ClientSecret for authentication
assertions.rationale: IntrospectTokenAsync with ClientId catalog-api / ClientSecret api-secret.

assertions.assertion: Code checks the IsActive property (or 'active' field) of the introspection response to determine if the token is valid
Response explains that reference tokens are opaque identifiers (not self-contained JWTs) and require server-side validation via introspection
assertions.rationale: Only says reference tokens can't be validated locally; never describes them as opaque identifiers versus self-contained JWTs.

assertions.assertion: Response mentions that reference tokens enable immediate revocation unlike JWTs which are valid until expiry
assertions.rationale: No mention of immediate revocation versus JWT validity until expiry.
